caption:
Singer Sri Lanka sales up 21% 📺📈

July to September 2026 results: sales rose 21% to Rs 35.68 billion. Operating profit grew 20% to Rs 3.71 billion.

Higher interest costs pulled quarterly profit down 5.5% to Rs 1.36 billion. For the six months, profit is up 19.6% to Rs 3.50 billion.

Source: Singer (Sri Lanka) PLC interim financial statements, CSE
